schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Blue Lake Upper (Region 2, Alpine Co.) for sub-catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of May-September. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Blue Lake Upper (Region 2, Alpine Co.) for fingerling-size Lahontan Cutthroat Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of May-September (the species name is wrapped across two lines in the PDF table row). This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
